lines: No calibration. Put it on, and it works.

Calibration is a good solution to imprecise tracking, but with a new generation of hardware we knew we needed to do better.
Pro pairs all-new hardware with a brand new model. You won't tune a single slider or need to pay attention to the app running in the background at all.
Pro uses two state-of-the-art cameras for substantially better coverage of the lower face.

A single camera only fits in so many places while still seeing everything it needs to. Two cameras let us design the hardware around the person wearing it, giving us far more freedom for comfort and ergonomics.
Frame is a standalone headset, so every component affects battery life. Pro is designed to draw less than half the power of our current hardware.
Tracking runs directly on the device. Instead of streaming video over Wi-Fi to your PC, Pro sends only the tracking data, cutting latency and network load.
